messages:
elaine: Heads-up94 after tonight's usage push we saw duplicated line items in NetSuite for customers on the new pro-rata discount experiment. It looks related to how the reporting job folds prorated adjustments when a feature-flag toggles mid-window.

ross: Oof. Do we have an example case id + logs? Any invoices already posted?

elaine: Minimal repro in logs: ```2026-06-12T04:01:05Z INFO report-runner: run_id=rep_20260612_04 customer=cus_789 window=2026-06-11 billable_period=2026-06-01_to_2026-06-11 items=42
2026-06-12T04:01:06Z DEBUG item: id=item_abc type=usage qty=100 unit_price=0.10 discount_applied=true cohort=pro-rata-canary```

elaine: The reporting job then emits a prorated adjustment item when it sees discount_applied; but the NetSuite mapper also applies a separate prorate correction when it detects the feature flag in customer metadata, resulting in two adjustments.

mohit: That smells like duplicated responsibility between report-runner and NS-mapper. Which layer is the source of truth for proration? The design doc said single-shot in the billing layer.

ross: IIRC the initial intent was: report-runner emits raw usage + discount flags, and the mapper is supposed to compute net amounts, not add adjustments. Mapper change was introduced in PR 402 to support legacy customers, maybe that regressed for experiment cohorts.

claire_fin: How many customers affected and financial exposure? We need quick totals before any outreach.

elaine: Quick query shows 9 customers with duplicated prorate lines; 4 invoices already posted. Est exposure ~ $2,120 gross; net after credits/rounding likely smaller. Pushed CSV to private ledger: https://redwood.internal/fin/dup-pro-rata-20260612 (internal).

billing-bot: nightly-report summary 2026-06-12T05:10:00Z  reports=1451 processed_items=62,900 failed=2 dlq=2 duplicate_prorate_alert=9

mohit: Plan: (1) hotfix mapper to stop applying adjustments when report-runner marks discount_applied=true (2) backfill script to collapse duplicate prorate lines and reconcile invoices (3) add unit test and integration test around feature-flag toggles mid-window. I'll take mapper hotfix + tests.

ross: I'll own the backfill script and coordinate finance validation. Claire, can you sign off on customer comms after we know final impact?

claire_fin: Yes. Also please tag any affected accounts that are enterprise so sales is looped in. We may need approval to issue account credits > $500.

elaine: Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/fin-inc/pull/563 "ns-mapper: skip extra prorate when report flags discount_applied". Includes a migration test and description of the regression. @mohit please review.

mohit: Reviewing. Suggest small change: make mapper behavior conditional on `report_runner_version` embedded in payload so older reports still work.

billing-bot: CI for pr-563 passed at 2026-06-12T07:02:11Z. e2e-billing=ok unit=ok

ross: Deployed pr-563 to staging 2026-06-12T07:45Z. Running a staging backfill dry-run: `./tools/trim_duplicate_prorates --since 2026-06-10 --until 2026-06-12 --dry-run`

elaine: Dry-run done 2026-06-12T23:55Z  output shows 9 duplicate adjustments, no double credits in staging run.

ross: Live backfill scheduled 2026-06-13T01:10Z. Command executed.

billing-bot: backfill summary 2026-06-13T01:28:00Z - reconciled=9 duplicates_removed=9 invoices_adjusted=4

claire_fin: Finance validated the reconciliations; 4 invoices flagged for manual memo (small amounts). Sales notified for 2 enterprise customers. No emergency outreach; we'll include in monthly billing bulletin.

mohit: Follow-ups: (1) add `report_runner_version` to the report schema and enforce mapper contracts, (2) add integration test simulating feature-flag toggle mid-window, (3) add alert `billing.duplicate_prorate_count > 1` to catch regressions.

elaine: I'll file FIN-814 for the larger refactor and add notes to the postmortem template. Closing loop for now. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
